quotes.text: Missing Content-Type header for request with body

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The shared sender translates the already-built request's method, URI and headers, then sets a supplied authentication header. It does not rebuild the URI from an updated base URL. A nonempty body requires Content-Type; an empty body skips that body-specific requirement. Callers must distinguish configuration used to build a later request from the immutable URI already queued for retries. This is source inspection, not an authentication or configuration-change test.
title: The shared sender preserves the queued URI while adding current authentication
